due_when.clears_when: dispatch_queue skips a unit whose precondition is unmet, proven by a test, and RQ-20260930-502 is switched to the structured field

origin.rerun: grep dispatch_queue.py for dispatch_precondition; construct a queued unit with an unmet precondition and confirm whether it is selected.

what: dispatch_queue.py never reads research-unit `dispatch_precondition` (RQ-20260930-502 carries one in prose: dispatch only after RQ-501's MEASURED PASS record is on main). A queued unit with such a field would dispatch within ~6h of merge regardless. Make dispatch_queue honour dispatch_precondition (or an equivalent structured field, e.g. a `requires_record: RQ-...` naming the unit whose measured pass record must be on main), skipping the unit until it holds, with a test that a unit with an unmet precondition is not dispatched and one with a met precondition is.
